{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u082/system/state/workspace/programs/task-98da8e38.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    flat = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    counts = Counter(flat)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The regular lattice color is usually the most frequent color other than
    # the large-area fill color.
    line_color = next((c for c, _ in counts.most_common() if c != background), background)

    def modal_line(values):
        c, n = Counter(values).most_common(1)[0]
        return c, n / len(values)

    # Keep rows/columns that are predominantly the lattice color. Colored
    # markers interrupt these otherwise uniform separator lines.
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h)
                 if modal_line(grid[r])[0] == line_color and modal_line(grid[r])[1] >= 0.65]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w)
                 if modal_line([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)])[0] == line_color
                 and modal_line([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)])[1] >= 0.65]

    # Only lattice columns carrying at least one non-line marker are nodes in
    # the pattern; plain outer/boundary lines are discarded.
    node_cols = [c for c in col_lines
                 if any(grid[r][c] != line_color for r in row_lines)]

    if len(row_lines) < 2 or len(node_cols) < 2:
        return [[background]]

    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(row_lines, row_lines[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(node_cols, node_cols[1:]):
            vals = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            row.append(vals[0] if vals.count(vals[0]) == 4 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
"
}
